nodes.name: Zn-doped FeNiSe2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: ZnFeNiSe2 synthesized on nickel foam substrate via selenization of metal precursors, preserving NiSe2 host lattice structure (PDF#41-1495) with 0.35 nm (111) interplanar spacing, confirmed by AC-HAADF-STEM and XRD showing systematic peak shift due to doping-induced lattice contraction.
nodes.source_text: To validate the rational architecture of M_v-FeNiOOH, we synthesized an electrocatalyst derived from the electrochemical activation of Zn-doped FeNiSe2 (A-ZnFeNiSe)... The (111) plane in ZnFeNiSe2 exhibited a 0.35 nm interplanar spacing

nodes.name: Electrochemical reconstruction
nodes.procedure: Electrochemical activation in alkaline electrolyte (1M KOH) via cyclic voltammetry or chronopotentiometry, involving preferential Zn leaching (Zn: -0.76V vs SHE) over Fe (-0.44V) and Ni (-0.23V), complete Se removal with O enrichment via Se→O exchange, forming ~5 nm low-crystallinity Zn_v-FeNiOOH surface layer with 0.24 nm (101) γ-NiOOH spacing while suppressing Fe dissolution.
nodes.source_text: electrochemical activation of Zn-doped FeNiSe2 (A-ZnFeNiSe)... complete Se leaching and oxygen enrichment, verifying a Se-O exchange-driven phase transition to hydroxyoxides... preferential Zn leaching, which suppresses Fe dissolution

nodes.characterization_summary: ZnFeNiSe2 (111) plane shows 0.35 nm interplanar spacing consistent with NiSe2 structure (PDF#41-1495); A-ZnFeNiSe2 after activation shows ~5 nm amorphous layer with 0.24 nm d-spacing of γ-NiOOH (101) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The (111) plane in ZnFeNiSe2 exhibited a 0.35 nm interplanar spacing (Figure 2b), consistent with the NiSe2 structure (PDF#41-1495)... A-ZnFeNiSe2 retained short-range order, with a 0.24 nm d-spacing consistent with the (101) plane of γ-NiOOH (JCPDF 06-0075), indicating the formation of low-crystallinity hydroxyoxides (Figure 2b,c).

nodes.characterization_summary: ZnFeNiSe2 shows cubic FeNiSe2 peaks at 30.2°, 33.8°, 37.2°, 43.1°, 51.0°, 55.7°, 58.1°, 62.5° for (200), (210), (211), (220), (311), (230), (321) planes with rightward shift; A-ZnFeNiSe2 shows attenuated peak intensity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns (Figure 2d), the peaks at 30.2°, 33.8°, 37.2°, 43.1°, 51.0°, 55.7°, 58.1°, and 62.5° can be ascribed to the (200), (210), (211), (220), (311), (230), and (321) planes of cubic FeNiSe2, respectively.

properties.peaks: Multiple sharp peaks with asterisk marked features

nodes.characterization_summary: A-ZnFeNiSe2 composition is Zn (1.75 at%), Fe (18.90 at%), Ni (79.35 at%); post-activation electrolyte confirms preferential Zn leaching suppressing Fe dissolution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) quantified the composition of A-ZnFeNiSe2 as Zn (1.75 at%), Fe (18.90 at%), and Ni (79.35 at%) (Table S1, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: A-ZnFeNiSe2 shows marked increase in Fe/Ni oxidation states vs A-FeNiSe2, Ni3+/Ni2+ ratio 2.62 (vs 1.69), coexistence of Fe2+/Fe3+; O 1s region shows higher M-OH proportion 39.2% vs 26.1% for A-FeNiSe2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For A-ZnFeNiSe2, a marked increase in the oxidation states of Fe and Ni was observed... the Ni3+/Ni2+ ratio in A-ZnFeNiSe2 (2.62) significantly surpassed that of A-FeNiSe2 (1.69)... high-resolution XPS of the O 1s region (Figure 6c), which showed a higher proportion of M-OH bonds in A-ZnFeNiSe2 (39.2%) compared to A-FeNiSe2 (26.1%).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni-K and Fe-K edge XANES of A-ZnFeNiSe2 closer to NiOOH/FeOOH confirming high oxidation states; EXAFS shows contracted M-O bonds (R_Ni-O=2.09 Å, R_Fe-O=2.00 Å vs 2.12/2.05 Å in references) and elongated M-M bonds (R_Ni-Ni/Fe=3.10 Å, R_Fe-Fe/Ni=3.05 Å).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni-K edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra of the samples (Figure 3d) revealed that A-ZnFeNiSe2 exhibited an absorption edge position closer to NiOOH... The fitting results revealed contracted M-O bond lengths (R_Ni-O = 2.09 Å, R_Fe-O = 2.00 Å vs 2.12 and 2.05 Å in NiOOH/FeOOH, respectively), indicative of strengthened M-O covalency (Figure 3f,g).

nodes.characterization_summary: ZnFeNiSe2 shows attenuation of M-Se modes and emergence of MOOH peaks at 474 cm⁻¹ (Eg) and 557 cm⁻¹ (Alg) of γ-NiOOH; high Iδ/Iν ratio indicates γ-NiOOH formation at lower potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To elucidate the true active species during the OER, we performed operando Raman spectroscopy... The Raman peaks at 474 and 557 cm⁻¹ can be assigned to the Eg and Alg modes of γ-NiOOH, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: A-ZnFeNiSe2 shows stronger OH peak intensity at 3200-3500 cm⁻¹ associated with O-H stretching vibrations of OH⁻ with increasing potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ attenuated total reflection Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (ATR-FTIR) was further employed... The broad peaks spanning 3200-3500 cm⁻¹, associated with O-H stretching vibrations of OH⁻, intensified with increasing applied potential.

nodes.characterization_summary: Selenide nanosheets post-activation show morphological integrity with increased surface roughness aligning with reduced crystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis (Figures S10 and S11, Supporting Information) confirmed morphological integrity of selenide nanosheets post-activation, with increased surface roughness aligning with reduced crystallinity.

nodes.characterization_summary: A-ZnFeNiSe2 shows highest C_dl among series and negative shift with enlarged adsorption peak area in 0.8-1.0 V vs RHE range indicating enhanced electrochemical OH- adsorption kinetics and capacity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemical active surface area (ECSA) of the samples was systematically investigated through cyclic voltammetry measurements at varying scan rates... A-ZnFeNiSe2 demonstrated the highest C_dl value... cyclic voltammetry (CV) experiments were conducted (Figure 6b). At a pH of 14, the CV profiles in the 0.8-1.0 V vs RHE range revealed electrochemical OH- adsorption characteristics.

nodes.characterization_summary: A-ZnFeNiSe2 shows static contact angle of 27.74° vs 53.77° for A-FeNiSe2 in 1 M KOH indicating significantly stronger OH- affinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The affinity of the electrocatalysts for OH- was first evaluated with the static contact angle measurements (Figure 6a). The A-ZnFeNiSe2 exhibited significantly stronger affinity for OH- (27.74°) than A-FeNiSe2 (53.77°).
